scope: Native us-east-1 CloudFormation control plane on one exact-created two-AZ provisioned MSK cluster. Every mapping remained disabled and the Lambda function had reserved concurrency zero. No topic creation, Kafka client, producer, records or Lambda invocations occurred.

measured.missing_topic_admission: Fresh disabled CFN mapping reached CREATE_COMPLETE although the requested topic was never created.

consumer_group.execution: Both request a new physical resource, then Lambda409 duplicate cluster+function+topics. Both UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE; original UUID retained.

topics.execution: Both fail in resource with InvalidRequest: Parameter 'Topics' can not be updated. Both UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE and same UUID.

qualified_function_targets.execution: Base function to first alias to second alias to base all UPDATE_COMPLETE in place with returned FunctionArn changed and UUID retained.

position_replacement.execution: Changing an omitted starting position to explicit LATEST or explicit TRIM_HORIZON, or AT_TIMESTAMP with a valid timestamp, requests replacement and collides on cluster+consumerGroupId. Original mapping survives rollback.

timestamp_required.execution: AT_TIMESTAMP without timestamp requests replacement then native Lambda400 requires starting position timestamp; rollback preserves original.

successful_replacement.changes: AT_TIMESTAMP with timestamp plus new consumer group plus new topic

timestamp_change_and_removal.execution: Changing only timestamp on the successful AT_TIMESTAMP mapping, and removing position plus timestamp, both request replacement then collide on cluster+group. Both roll back with surviving UUID.

source_access_introduction.execution: All UPDATE_COMPLETE in place, but SourceAccessConfigurations remains absent from native response. Introduction from absent template property is ignored. This does not measure removal of observed credentials.

combined_property_precedence.execution: Changing group and topic with an authentication property, without a create-only change, fails in-resource Topics-can-not-be-updated before replacing. The finding label describes an attempted contrast, not successful replacement or authentication rejection.

measured.deletion: Owned stack reached DELETE_COMPLETE, both observed mapping UUIDs returned ResourceNotFoundException. Owned function, aliases, published version, execution role/policy and dummy secret were verified absent. Cluster, security group, both subnets and VPC were verified absent. Exact-created service-linked role ARN+RoleId was fenced before deletion; role absence and native deletion-task SUCCEEDED were both observed.

unknown: Omitted Enabled behavior was not exercised: mappings stayed explicitly disabled for safety.
Removal/retention of genuinely observed MSK SCRAM credentials was not established. Do not transfer the self-managed Kafka result or infer it from absent authentication controls.
The combined group/topic/authentication attempt did not reach fresh authenticated creation; it failed immutable-topic validation. It is not evidence that MSK SCRAM authentication is unsupported.
Actual data-plane connectivity, delivery, offsets, consumer-group progress and Lambda invocation were intentionally not exercised.
The native omitted batching window response does not expose a numerical 500ms value; 500ms is a primary-documentation statement, not a returned native field.
No direct published-version target update was measured; qualified-target transitions used two aliases of the owned published version.
recovery: A reviewed durable-inventory handoff observed the already submitted explicit-latest update to terminal without resubmission. A native service-linked-role deletion-status NoSuchEntity immediately after DeleteServiceLinkedRole was retained; later IN_PROGRESS, terminal SUCCEEDED and role absence were observed. No unrelated resources were modified to satisfy cleanup.
